data.content_ref: inline:Since the variator emits k bounded edits per step and most of the attack graph is unchanged, cache the prior label assignment and recompute only the affected subgraph, emitting a certificate that the result is the least fixed point. Determinism is preserved because the certificate verifies uniqueness of the fixpoint regardless of iteration order; cost stays polynomial and amortizes better than full recomputation because the edit is bounded and relabeling is monotone. This targets the real cost center — the edges, not the fixpoint — keeping the extension cheap enough to run at every loop step.
